batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c R Tewatia b Rashid Khan

batting.name: Vishnu Vinod
batting.dismissal: c A Manohar b MM Sharma

batting.name: HH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c Ishan Kishan b JP Behrendorff

batting.name: R Tewatia
batting.dismissal: c C Green b PP Chawla

balls.text: first T20 hundred for Suryakumar Yadav, and it was always a question of when rather than if. Gets there in trademark fashion too. Full, aiming for the wide yorker, but maybe not wide or full enough for it. Steps across and gets down on his back knee, in a flash, to sweep it up and over the backward square leg boundary. What an innings, 49 balls of T20 genius

Steps across to whip this low full-toss from outside off stump, and the square leg fielder dives to his right and gets a hand to the ball to stop the ball from running away for four. Only a half-stop, though, and SKY runs a second to get back on strike
moves to 95! Misses the length on the wide yorker, and this time ends up bowling in the slot. Frees his arms and flat-bats it straight of mid-off and high, and easily clears the boundary
he can, of course, but Joseph has made it difficult. A quick, wide full-toss. Attempted the wide yorker and missed his length, but SKY, looking to make room to slash it away, can't put bat to ball
looks for the wide yorker, and gets his line right even if it isn't quite full enough to be a yorker. Reaches out and swipes it to the right of long-on, off the inside half of the bat

excellent wide yorker, but he can't keep Green at the striker's end. Looks to make room and stab it square on the off side, only manages to jam the ball down into the pitch, and it rolls away a couple of yards into the off side. Far enough away from the bowler to sneak a single, though, and the crowd roars its approval

four more. Looks to go hard length and angle into leg stump to try and cramp SKY for room. He steps across his stumps, though, and gets enough bat on this swipe - the ball hit the bat sticker - to beat fine leg diving to his right
full-toss on off stump, and Green punches it down to long-off and brings SKY back on strike
off the thigh pad. Steps across to try and access the fine leg region, and misses a swipe off a back of a length ball, angling down leg. Rolls down to the right of deep fine

and now he goes conventional, almost. Full, angling in towards off stump, and he leans back to sink to his back knee, and lofts it over extra-cover, gets it into the gap between deep cover point and long-off

and that's why you don't want SKY on strike. I don't have a name for this shot. Fullish, angling in towards offstump, and SKY steps away to the leg side to create room, to play what starts off as a lofted off-drive, except he uses his wrists to slice underneath the ball and hit it over short third. Over short third. For six

back of a length, angling in towards off stump, cramping Green on the pull, played all along the ground to deep midwicket for a single. Usually the outcome every bowler wants in T20, but not when it brings SKY on strike

slower ball, angling in to out and finishing outside the wide tramline, but SKY doesn't want wides, he wants boundaries. Goes back and a long way across, and plays an otherwise old-fashioned cut to beat deep backward point haring to his left

and now he goes over the covers. Slower ball outside off, not too wide, and he can't quite generate the power he needs to get it to the boundary. Bounces down to the right of Vijay Shankar sprinting to his right from deep backward point

you can angle it as far away to the off side as you want, but SKY can still hit you over square leg. Walks across, then stretches and sinks onto his back knee to sweep it, flat and powerful, and clear the boundary with a shot that would drop our jaws if we hadn't already seen it a hundred times
slower ball wide of off stump, angling away again. Looks to reach out and slash, gets a thick outside edge that rolls to short third
full-toss now, wide of off stump, and SKY brings his wrists into play to slice it up and over the leaping fielder at backward point
tries that in-to-out angle again with the slower ball, but it's just within Surya's arc and he reaches out to flat-bat it over extra-cover

four wickets, and what a fourth wicket! David goes early. Full legbreak on off stump, and David is out for the softest of dismissals. Was looking to work it to long-on, but the ball pitches shorter than he expects, and he ends up squaring up and slicing the ball back to the bowler at stomach height
and you can see why. Wrong'un pitched outside off, and David gets forward uncertainly to push to long-off. Turns less than he expects, and the thick edge runs away to the right of slip
length ball outside off, leans back to cut to the left of deep cover point
shortish wrong'un finishes at the pads, and David is off the mark with a single worked to the left of deep backward square leg
looks for another sweep from a little further outside off, inside-edges it to deep backward square leg

Oh, that's superb. Again that big gap between deep backward square leg and deep midwicket, but you need to be an outstanding sweeper to access it against Rashid Khan. Length ball, legbreak straightening from close to off stump, and he stretches out and hammers it along the ground

now he goes for the off-stump line, and ends up bowling a full-toss while probably targeting the yorker. I don't think it's above waist height, though the umpires have a look. Vinod looks to slog it away and ends up slicing it high, caught by deep backward square leg coming in off the rope. Vinod is walking away, but the umpires ask him to wait. Yup, it's not above waist height
shortish slower ball, and the in-to-out angle would have taken this past the tramline if SKY had left it, but he steps across and slaps it to deep cover point instead
uses the in-to-out angle again and nails the wide yorker. SKY looks to use his wrists and stab it square, but he can't put bat to ball
again the angle. On-pace this time, looks for the wide yorker and ends up bowling a full-toss, and he's lucky that SKY, opening his bat face, finds backward point rather than a gap either side of him
again the angle away. Bowls from close to the stumps and targets the tramline with a slower ball. Shorter than the previous one, and he looks to cut but misses
interesting delivery, goes low arm and angles this good-length slower ball away towards the wide tramline. Vinod flat-bats it down to long-on
back of a length on off stump, clipped to midwicket off the back foot
there's that skipping lofted drive again, over mid-off and all the way for six. In the slot, angling in towards off stump, and SKY just does his thing, leaning back with left elbow high
full, angling in towards off stump. Too full to get underneath, and he whips it along the ground to long-on
goes wider on the crease and goes back of a length, angling in to finish around fifth stump. Slapped to deep cover point
length ball, offers width, and that's a bad idea with mid-off and extra-cover in the circle. SKY flat-bats it and gets it into the gap between them
in the blockhole on off stump. Gets his feet out of the way but can't drive it past extra-cover
good ball. Tossed up wrong'un outside off, dips on Vishnu as he reaches out to drive into the covers, and turns to beat his outside edge
goes back to the flat length ball skidding towards off stump, and clips to long-on

wrong'un, and SKY takes on the sweep against the turn. Shuffles across first because Noor has angled this wide of off, and he doesn't quite middle it, but the thick top edge carries well over short fine leg, to his left, and bounces to the right of deep backward square leg
tossed up, wrong'un spinning away from off stump, driven to sweeper cover
full on leg stump, clipped to long-on

and Vishnu keeps showing off his range. Sees him shape for the reverse-sweep and fires it wide of off stump, but his quick hands catch up with the ball in a flash, and he slaps it away to the right of slip
ohoho, that's the trademark lofted SKY drive, finishing with both feet off the ground. In the slot outside off, and he gets under it and lifts himself up and lifts the ball over mid-off
now Shami follows his movement to leg, goes full and at his feet, and he clips it down to long-on for one
looks to make room to go off-side again, and is beaten by a blockhole ball outside off

WOW. Not too many more breathtaking shots have been hit in this tournament. Length ball finishing on top of off stump, and he makes room and flat-bats it with a crisp sound off the bat and sends it sailing over the cover boundary
wow. He's good at this shot alright. Just marginally short, finishing around off stump, and he clears his front leg and hoicks it over midwicket
length ball outside off, and Vinod, looking to slash it square, is beaten on the outside edge

now it's SKY's turn to hit a pulled six. Has to fetch it from wider outside off, but it sits up nicely at around chest height and he can hit it nicely from down to up, over the boundary in front of square
hard length, finishes around the off bail, clears his front leg a little and pulls along the floor to deep forward square leg

shot! Vishnu Vinod's first IPL six, and it's a beaut. Short, would have got up to shoulder height outside off, but he picks the length so quickly that he's able to extend his arms fully on the pull, meets it before it gets up to that height and hammers it over the square leg boundary
back of a length, a bit of inward nip from outside off. Doesn't bounce enough to pull, and the bat turns in his hands as he swipes to midwicket
fullish, fairly wide of off stump. Wants SKY to take a single to the cover sweeper and get off strike, and gets his wish
length ball angling into the stumps, clipped quietly down to long-on
length ball finishing on middle and off, goes back to work it to deep midwicket
beautifully bowled. Lovely length on the wrong'un that turns away from a middle-stump line. Gets forward to push towards long-off, maybe, but it turns sharply past his outside edge
full and at SKY's front shoe. Gets his foot away from the line and whips to the right of long-on
flat wrong'un finishing within the stumps. Defends watchfully towards the non-striker, and Noor throws himself to his left to stop it from running away for a single
tossed up outside leg, swept to long leg

ooh, nicely bowled. Premeditates a front-foot whip to the leg side, but the ball is slightly shorter than he thinks, and turns past his inside edge. Doesn't turn enough against the angle to hit off stump, though. The umpires send it upstairs because there's a stumping appeal, but SKY has his foot grounded juuust behind the crease
length ball outside off, lets it come and dabs to deep third
length ball close to off stump, presses forward to punch to deep cover point

shot! Slightly overpitched outside off, though not a genuine half-volley. Surya takes a stride forward and punches it on the up, finishing with high left elbow as the ball flies away to the right of mid-off
fullish outside off, gets on the front foot to push to the left of deep cover point
back of a length outside off, punched to deep cover point
back of a length close to off stump. Doesn't quite come on to the bat, and the attempted off-side punch ends up as a defensive jab back to the bowler

wicket No. 3! Legbreak, doesn't straighten towards the stumps but keeps going with the angle from right-arm over. Looks to make room to cut, and the ball doesn't bounce as much as he expects. Thick inside edge into the stumps
another sweep, from a straighter line this time, down to deep backward square leg

wrong'un pitching outside off, and Kishan hammers the sweep. Big stretch forward, and his hands go full extension to sweep it powerfully through the big gap at square leg. No one in the circle, just a big gap between deep backward square leg and deep midwicket
goes back to a legbreak finishing on leg stump, works it to the left of deep midwicket
chipped, and it bounces a few yards short of long-off coming in off the rope. Not quite to the pitch of the ball for the inside-out drive, and he checks his shot at the last moment
flat length ball straightening towards off stump, goes back to defend it back to the bowler
shortish, keeps a little low on off stump, has to adjust because he was shaping for the full-blooded pull. Hits a short-arm jab to the left of deep midwicket

in Wadhera's hitting arc again, too full, and on the stumps this time. So impressive that he's putting them away so cleanly so early in his innings. Clears his front leg and launches it high and straight
flatter, straightens slightly towards the pads, worked to the left of deep midwicket
tossed up wide of off stump, overpitches, and Wadhera puts it away with a flat-bat drive, drilled to the left of extra-cover and long-off has no chance
full outside off, whipped down to long-on
flat one slanting across to finish near off stump. Not short enough for the late cut, and he inside-edges into the ground. Doesn't miss off stump by much
quick length ball on the stumps, gets forward and blocks to short extra-cover

wrong ball to sweep. Full and on the stumps, and Kishan probably just premeditated this. Sneaks under the bat and straightens to smack his back thigh - the back pad is fully on the ground. Rashid only appeals because it's required of him, and Kishan doesn't even review. Ball-tracking has it hitting middle and off halfway up
another sweep! A little fuller, and SKY hits it a little firmer in the same direction. Another fumble from Noor, but this time the ball doesn't get away too far from him

sweeps again. Similar delivery and he really gets the stretch out to hit it along the ground to deep backward square leg, where Noor fumbles a straightforward collection and lets it slip through his fingers to the boundary
ooh, misses a sweep first ball off a wrong'un, but he's stretched a long way forward and across and the impact is outside off stump

and they get it! Caught at slip no less. Quick legbreak, turns away from a perfect length on off stump. It would be a testing delivery in a Test match, and Rohit, going forward to defend, nicks it. Good catch from Tewatia, had to move quickly to his left and he made it look simple

flat, on the fuller side of a length, angling in to leg stump. Kishan had stepped away to the leg side initially, then he pulls his front leg out of the way to make more hitting room and sinks to his back knee to slog-sweep over midwicket
better length, wrong'un spinning in from outside off. Looks for the slog-sweep, only manages to inside-edge into his body
half-volley outside off, and Kishan would put that away at any time, but now there's a gaping invitation because mid-off is up in the circle. Clears him easily, and clears the rope too
sees Rohit step leg side and looks to follow him with a full ball. Lofts it to mid-on's right, and deep midwicket  runs around to cut it off
makes room to expose all his stumps, and cuts a wrong'un from in front of the stumps, but can't beat short third
short wrong'un, turning into the left-hander's body. Swings it out to deep backward square leg

tries another sweep, and the wrong'un turns to hit Rohit's pad, but it seems to be headed down leg. Both Rashid and Tewatia, the slip fielder, seem convinced, though, and Titans have reviewed... Pitches on the shorter side of a length, and sneaks under the bat, misses the glove as well... the impact is on leg stump, and the ball is turning in, so Titans lose that review

sweeps again, and this time it nearly goes all the way. Similar line, but this was the legbreak, I think. Didn't turn too much so he could hit it against the turn, but doesn't quite middle it. Plops into the turf to the right of deep midwicket, from where Vijay Shankar makes a long sprint to slap the ball back into play
this time the line is closer to off stump and the length a touch fuller, and Rohit nails the sweep, up over square leg
wrong'un, pitching on the shorter side of a length wide of off stump. Looks to get down low and sweep, ends up inside-edging into the ground and then his body
length ball on middle and leg, goes back to work it to square leg's right
steps out, gets too close to the pitch of the ball to hit over the top, ends up swiping it to square leg off the inside half of the bat
slower short ball, takes ages to reach Kishan at around stomach height. Has to wait a long time before using his wrists to work it to the left of deep square leg
shot. Back of a length, sits up nicely on a leg-stumpish line, and Kishan swats it away easily over midwicket
slower ball, back of a length, angling away from off stump. Pulls but can't manufacture enough power to beat midwicket diving to his left
very full, angling in towards off stump, jabbed into the gap to the left of extra-cover
back of a length, angling in towards off stump, punched to short extra-cover, where Vijay Shankar moves quickly forward to cut it off
full, loopy slower ball on leg stump. Moves to the leg side to stab towards mid-off

Six more. Down the track now, and Rohit is stepping leg-side so Shami looks to go wider with his line and make him reach for the ball. Doesn't go wide enough, though, and Rohit is able to free his arms and lift it effortlessly over the cover boundary

down the track to the length ball finishing around off stump, and he swipes across the line to get it to Rashid's left at mid-on. Chases back, and he seems to have it under control with the slide, but he fails to pull it back cleanly with his hand and has to go scrambling after the ball. Tight call whether he touched the boundary cushions with his body while pulling the ball in. Doesn't appear to have, but it's tight
back of a length around off stump, defended with an open face to backward point

length ball now, on the stumps, makes room to try and launch it straight, but it hits the inside half of the bat and doesn't go too far, drops town 2/3rds of the way to the boundary to the right of mid-on

now Kishan hits his first six. Not the worst short ball, because it got up to chest height and finished around off stump, not offering a whole lot of room, but he puts it away without even swivelling. Just quick reading of length and an extension of the arms, and it disappears over the backward square leg boundary
good length, straightens towards middle and leg to deny Kishan room. Stays leg-side of the ball to defend, gets a thick inside edge into his back leg
wow, that's a Rohit special. Good-length ball angling into the stumps, not short by any means, and he just stands there, opens his hip a bit, and whips it away, up and over the square leg boundary
length ball on off stump, defended towards mid-off. Thinks of a single but the ball rolls too quickly to the fielder to allow it
bam. Length ball on off stump, and Rohit skates away to the leg side to expose all three stumps and create room to swing freely through the line and launch it flat, back over the bowler's head
a bit of inswing, good length, and Rohit is stuck on the crease. Tries to flick it away and he misses, prompting a loud lbw appeal, but it's clearly missing leg stump
That's not where you bowl when you've set that field. Short and wide, and Rohit stands tall and frees his arms to slap it away between backward point and cover point
length ball close to off stump, stays on the back foot and punches to short extra-cover
half-volley on off stump, and Kishan is up and running, lofts it flat and straight of mid-off, back over the non-striker's head
full outside off, gets forward and opens his bat face to steer to the right of backward point, who dives to make a half-stop
ooooh, past the edge! Full and a wide line from Shami. Rohit drives without getting his front foot across, and the ball swings away to beat the outside edge
full on the pads, outside leg, misses the flick, and the ball rolls behind the wicket off the pad. Saha sprints and dives to his right to keep it down to one leg bye
good length, a hint of shape back into the stumps. Looks to get forward and push into the covers or mid-off, ends up inside-edging into his back pad
full, swinging in towards leg stump, clipped to square leg

fired full outside off, Rashid slices this on the bounce to point. So a dot-ball to end the game that Mumbai win comfortably, but would've ideally hoped to win by a much, much bigger margin, especially when they had Titans tottering on 103 for 8. Rashid Khan walks off to a standing ovation, he's provided this crowd some entertainment. The crowd too has lapped it up wholeheartedly knowing fully well there was little chance of Mumbai losing.
sees the batter trying to walk across and fires it full but it's way down leg, good stop by Kishan but it's wide.
top-edges this slog as he walks across to swing leg side, it's circling in the air for a long, long time. Jordan coming in from long-off can't hold on. They don't run so Rashid will remain on strike
clears long-on for another maximum! This wasn't hit anywhere near the middle but Rashid still managed to generate enough power to clear the ropes. That's some hitting. Sensational stuff.
take that! Walks across to off-stump and picks this up and over to clear deep midwicket. Incredible hitting right out of the top drawer.
beaten as Kartikeya slides one across from over the wicket, Rashid was looking to slash that over point
bowls into the stumps and gets walloped over wide long-on! Rashid is all wrist and power as he brings out the helicopter shot.
fires this quicker delivery way outside off, Rashid leaves and wide called.
through with the pull even before this slower ball arrived, beaten.
slower length ball on off, Joseph can only bunt it back to the bowler on his followthrough
beaten by a wide yorker, Joseph done in by lack of footwork that time
brings out the helicopter this time, one bounce to deep midwicket
the slower ball has disappeared. Rashid backs away, holds his shape and muscles this pull to clear deep midwicket.  This is now Rashid's highest T20 score
heaves one across the line, gets it off a thick inside edge to deep midwicket.  Rashid immediately clutched his right hammy, perhaps due to cramps.
swung away across the line to wide long-on

slower off-cutter but ends up spraying it wide outside off, Rashid beaten as he can't reach the delivery. Rohit challenges the wide call. Looks like it's just inside the line, the ball also zipped past the under-edge.

sweet connection, stunning connection.  Rashid brings up his half-century off just 21 balls.  Expects a bouncer that Green delivers gift-wrapped, Rashid swivels back and picks the bones out of this to clear deep square.
excellent comeback. Hits hard lengths as he bends his back, Rashid is trying to scoop but is beaten for pace
clubs that over deep midwicket! My word, the power he's generated off that is unbelievable. Green took the pace off, so Rashid has to force it. And he does so incredibly well.
excellent bouncer, pacy bouncer. Too quick for Rashid as he bails out of the pull at the last moment
punched to the edge of the ring at cover, they decide against a single so that Rashid can take strike.
dug into the pitch, Rashid heaves it into the gap between deep midwicket and wide long-on. This btw is Rashid's highest score in the IPL
off the inside edge for four! More frustration for Rohit. Jordan thinks he's nailed a superb yorker, Rashid is looking to flick but ends up getting some bat on it as it flies away to fine leg.
steps out and drags this shortish delivery to wide long-on
he's not giving up. he's having loads of fun! Jordan bangs one short, Rashid uses the pace this time to play the upper cut and clears third man comfortably.
bludgeoned in front of square for four! Jordan digs one short outside off, Rashid clears his front leg and swats that with disdain.
skids one back in to hit Joseph's pad as it rolls to short third. Impact way outside leg, no question of an lbw. That's the end of Madhwal's spell. What a performance.

high full toss that Joseph reaches out to slap it to sweeper cover where Behrendorff does wonderfully well to slide and stop. Covered nearly 25 yard to get to the ball. But sadly, his knees were touching the skirting as he pulled the ball back in. Full marks for his effort though.
swing and a miss. Joseph looks to mow this incoming length ball over cow corner but was too early into the slog
cramped for room as Madhwal bowls short, the ball lobs over the bowler and a single is all they will get
skids one back in off a length on middle and leg, the ball hurries onto him, deflects off the pad to the off side
float it on a length on off from wide of the crease, punched back
slapped down to long-off
firmly driven to wide long-off, called for two but will have to be happy with a single
another short ball dug in but it's way over Rashid's head, wide called and rightly so
predictable response. He bowls short into the body, Rashid ducks under the bouncer this time
bowls a slower ball and gets whacked over cover again! Rashid makes room and waits and then swings through cleanly as it arrives to clear sweeper cover. Incredible hit.
looks to go over cover but ends up slicing it off a thick edge over short third.
tucks this length ball on middle to deep square
shortish on middle, bunted to mid-on
this one's clobbered nearly into the second tier at deep midwicket. This one's slower through the air, tossed up and Rashid absolutely nailed this as he went hard with the slog sweep.
what an incredible hit! That's simply lofted through the line inside-out over cover. Rashid stepped out but still went through with the shot even though he didn't get underneath the length.
punches to long-off

another one for Kartikeya with that simple policy of 'you miss, I hit.' Bowls length into the pitch from around the stumps, Noor steps out to swing this over deep midwicket but misses it altogether and is bowled.
chops it into the covers
can only hit this as far back as the bowler.
plays it nice and late, rolls past short third and they scamper back for the second
fired full, he lunges forward and defends
pushed through quicker outside off, defended
works this googly down to long-on to get off the mark

the wheels are coming off! Tewatia attempts the slog sweep, hits it really well but it's almost as if he forgot there was a fielder patrolling the longest boundary at deep backward square. Cam Green covered good ground to his right to take the catch.

Miller has been given out lbw but he reviews immediately. It's a well-disguised cutter that angles back in from around the stumps to cramp Miller for room, he's hit flush on the back thigh and ball tracking comes back to confirm this would've crashed into leg stump.
steps out to wallop that over cover, ends up bunting it to mid-off
swung across the line to deep midwicket, didn't get hold of that.
steers between backward point and short third as they scamper a single
swung away across the line to deep midwicket
...and is welcomed with a savage hit over cover! Length outside off, Miller stays besides the line and lofts through the line to clear extra cover. Terrific hit.
one bounce into the fence! Tewatia sees this tossed up, quickly gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps into the gap at wide long-on.
whips this into the gap at wide long-on, excellent running
shortish on middle, pulled to deep square
wrong'un off a length on middle, defended
cuts to deep point
dabs this wrong'un into the gap between cover and point
uses the pace of the bowler to help this pull to deep backward square
nails the pull but hits it straight to deep midwicket
cramped for room as he looks to take on the short ball with the pull, the inside edge rolls to the keeper
dug into the pitch, Tewatia pulls all along the ground to deep midwicket
steered to backward point for a single, good stop by Green
slower and fuller on the pads from around the stumps, worked to Surya at deep midwicket
off the inside edge as he looks to force it through the off side, gets the boundary. Streaky but it doesn't matter. All said, it wasn't far away from leg stump.
backs away and slaps this into the gap at deep cover
gets the edge and it races away past short third. This one's fired full and across, Miller is looking to drive but ends up nicking it for four.
that's in his arc and he's hit it out of the park! Tossed up on middle and leg, Miller clears his front leg and clobbers that over wide long-on.
lunges forward and drives to long-off
eased wide of point for a single
wonder if he bowled that seam-up, Miller backs away to cut but ends up driving past point because length is on the fuller side.
shortish on middle, punched to long-on
drills this low full toss to long-off.
bowls one quicker through the air again, Miller punches back, good stop by Kartikeya off his own bowling
pushed it into the off side to get off the mark immediately
gets him first ball! Rush of blood from Abhinav Manohar as he goes back to pull. Kartikeya gets this to drift in and skid through from around the stumps, beats Manohar's swing.
punches this down to long-on
crashes this shortish delivery to deep point
edged for four! Shapes to cut but this one flies off the edge past slip.
holds onto the surface a touch, Miller bunts it on the bounce to midwicket
this one's pushed through quicker on a length outside off, bunts it to point for a quick single

magicball from Chawla, legend! Unleashes a googly first up, draws Shankar forward but the ball dips and spins back in to beat the inside edge and crash into the stumps. Dream ball. The old dog still has plenty of miles left. He's absolutely rolling the clock back. Terrific, terrific display of proper legspin bowling.

good stop by Kishan, in fact outstanding! Miller tickles this leg-stump length delivery thinking he's got runs, until he sees Kishan throw himself full-stretch and stop the ball with his gloves off. Attempts a run-out at the bowler's end as he recovers quickly, Shankar, who was halfway down the pitch, comes back in the nick of time.

not timed as well as he would've liked but picks four anyway. Fetches the pull from outside off, got it off the bottom part but this outfield is fast and there's dew. The ball just skids across very quickly to the midwicket boundary.
takes pace off as he goes length on middle and leg, Shankar tucks it to deep square
pushed between cover and mid-off for another quick single
this one's on leg stump, Miller tickles it off the pad for two as he attempts a neat flick
punches to mid-off for a quick single
slashes but can't pick the gap at point
squeezes the drive to deep point
that's absolutely sublime! Pure wrist work to pick that length ball from middle through midwicket. Just raced away, no one moved. Outstanding stuff.
lovely touch that! Uses the pace of the bowler, opens the bat face late and steers this between backward point and short third. What timing.
pulled away superbly! Rolled his wrists nicely over the delivery to keep it down. Was in total control.
short of length on middle, tapped into the leg side. Looks for a single but is sent back
shows the full face and defends back this one that angles in

sends Gill' off-stump cartwheeling! Was Gill expecting it to bounce a lot more? Madhwal bowls a skiddy length ball on off, Gill attempts his trademark short-arm jab that he plays so well but misses it altogether and sees the stumps rattled. Madhwal is pumped and takes off on a celebratory run.
squeezed to mid-on as they scamper a quick single
pushed straight to cover point at the edge of the ring
stands tall and punches this through cover point. Picked length early, stood tall and put that away superbly.
beautiful timing! Errs in line as he slips it into middle and leg, Shankar brings his wrists out to whip this into the gap at midwicket.
troubled by the late inswing again, Gill gets an inside edge onto the pad, the ball lobs in the air briefly, but goes to ground before the bowler gets across.
tucks this down to long leg
sliced away over cover point for four! Shankar opened the bat face to meet the ball the moment he realised he wasn't going to get underneath the length.

that's a very un-Hardik like shot and he's gone! Bowls length again but in trying to angle it across, he has Hardik attempting a big bow into the leg side but ends up getting a nick through to Ishan Kishan. Hardik didn't even wait umpire to signal that out; was on his bike straightaway.
short and wide, asking to be hit, Hardik stands tall and slaps it straight to extra cover
slower length ball angling away, Gill stabs it behind square as they get through for a single
what a shot! Shows the full face of the bat as he punches a perfectly acceptable length delivery on middle. Just purred away to the boundary. So good to watch.

Saha has been struck high on the right thigh as he looked to whip it square, but has been adjudged lbw.  Initial impression: may have been a tad high.  He's been given out on the field, but the decision has been challenged. It's the skid off the pitch that beat Saha. Ball tracking comes back to suggest this would've clipped the bails, and  because it was given out on field, it'll remain out.  What a strike first up for the youngster. Talk about making an immediate impact.
punched to mid-on as they scamper a single. Tight line and length from Madhwal
excellent from Madhwal. Bowls a full'ish line around fourth-stump, Gill bunts it into the off side
lends direction to this short and wide delivery, steered into the gap at deep point for a couple
late movement away as Gill looks to cut a fullish delivery, beaten.
excellent. Length and nipping back into middle, defended back. Top over.
full and swinging back into middle and leg, Gill works it off his pads past midwicket
gets some late inward movement on this full delivery from outside off, Saha attempts a drive and squeezes one off the inner half of the bat to mid-on
pings the middle of the bat as Gill wrists this short of length delivery to deep square
hits hard length, the line is on middle and leg, Saha tucks it wide of midwicket and gets off the mark
slants a short of length ball across Saha who hops back and defends into the off side
